name: sherpa
description: Composable /frame, /shape, /decompose, /implement skills — one per layer (macro, shape, step, build) — with adversarial review at every boundary. The user composes the workflow; opt-in /persist for state.

interface.shortDescription: Composable frame, shape, decompose, and implement layers
interface.longDescription: Adds opt-in Sherpa skills — /frame (scout, bind a problem contract), /shape (fan out directions, pick one), /decompose (decompose into steps), /implement (build with per-step review) — that the user composes into a workflow. Nothing persists unless you call /persist.
defaultPrompt: Use /frame to shape this fuzzy task.
Use /shape to fan out competing directions and pick one.
Use /decompose to break this into steps.
Use /implement to build the approved plan.
